title: Document editor and PDF print review fixes
Template navs carry their admin area
PDF editor resource upload sends the resource key
system placeholder labels moved to the template-resolver namespace
detail: The labels of the system placeholders (tenantName, company data, page, imprint and so on) are now `template-resolver.systemPlaceholder.<name>` instead of `documentDesigner.placeholder.<name>`. The locale packages are already updated.
migration: An app that overrides a `documentDesigner.placeholder.<name>` translation renames the key to `template-resolver.systemPlaceholder.<name>`.

title: PDF template editor can hand a template to the AI assistant
Layout appearance, ruler and company data rail
PDF paper opens once its layout and placeholders are known
The template title is a rich-text field in front of the body
detail: The title above the PDF template body is a contenteditable field now, so the first `[contenteditable]` of the editor is the title, not the body. While the editor loads, a read-only placeholder carries the body id `document-designer-content`.
migration: In e2e specs, target the body with `#document-designer-content[contenteditable="true"]` instead of the first `[contenteditable]` of the editor.

title: Visible loading state in the PDF template editor
mail and PDF previews register in the preview registry
review round 2 document designer fixes
Template title helpers and editor screen ids exported
Template dates use the active app locale
Editors skip the branding query without managed-pages
PDF editor actions drop unreachable null checks
The PDF editor no longer saves or publishes the previous row after a scope switch
Split PDF, layout and mail editors into hooks and render functions
layout editor scope follows the entry screen
mail editor resets the record pick when variables change
Picked preview values are filtered to declared variables
Singular tenant counts in the override texts
Seeded layout titles show translated in the PDF editor and mail rail
Layout, mail and PDF template editors load lazily
Designer rails wrap instead of clipping
Long template names wrap in the template overview
Template overview shows locked tenant overrides
Mail preview fills the editor column
Designer screens are SystemAdmin-only unless the app passes access
detail: The templates screen, layout, PDF and mail editors are visible to SystemAdmin only by default. createDocumentDesignerFeature takes an optional access rule whose roles are added.
migration: Pass createDocumentDesignerFeature({ access: templateEditAccess(tenantEditable) }) with the same entries given to the template resolver when TenantAdmins edit templates.
